narrative: A fibre cut is most likely on AGG-01 (100% confidence). 17 valid alarms and 3 noise alarms were seen across 13 alarmed nodes. throughput_mbps on AGG-01 changed by -2316.2. Per runbook RB-FIBRE-AGG, reroute traffic to the backup path. Proposed action: reroute_traffic on AGG-01.

runbook.title: Fibre cut on aggregation node
runbook.excerpt: Shift traffic to the backup path or a sibling node using the pre-approved routing policy, then confirm packet loss falls below 1 percent. Applies to fibre cut at the aggregation tier.
